t: 2KW undersink stored water heater, providing hot water in areas with only a cold-water supply. Compact, wall-mounted unit with a 15-litre capacity. Features an adjustable thermostat from 30 to 75°C, and a LED heating status indicator. Durable triple-layer sapphire enamel-coated steel tank with insulation includes a replaceable sacrificial magnesium anode to help prevent corrosion and maintain performance.
